svg.title: MDA/2-2 within-scatter accuracy across row and column dimensions
svg.desc: Color maps show mean probe accuracy for 40,520 feasible dimension settings across gallery sizes using within-scatter projection axes. Each cell has exact mean and standard deviation in its title tooltip. The outlined cell is the highest probe mean for that gallery size; this selection is optimistic.
svg.text: Original 112×92 ORL · 5 matched splits · within-scatter axes · corrected Fig. 3 stopping rule · canonical direct grid
